translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Bunneni bu Nzambi ayi bunneni bu mutu
Nkunga Davidi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi mu ngitala yi basi Ngati.

content.text: Yave, Pfumu eto !
Tala buevi dizina diaku didi di nzitusu va ntoto wumvimba.
Ngeyo wutula nkemboꞌaku viokila diyilu.
Mu bididi bi bana balezi ayi bi bana batsombi,
ngeyo wutuma mu totukila nzitusu
mu diambu di bambeni ziaku ;
mu diambu di kanga miunu mi bobo beti ku lenda,
ayi mutu wowo wumvutulanga mambimbi mu mambimbi.
Bu ndieti tala diyilu diaku, kisalu ki minlembo miaku,
ngonda ayi zimbuetete ziozi wutula va buangu ;
buna mbi biobi mutu mu diambu wuntebukilanga moyo,
ayi muana mutu mu diambu wumbelanga mayindu e ?
Ngeyo wumvanga kaba fioti ku tsi bivangu bi diyilu
ayi ngeyo wumvuika nkembo ayi nzitusu,
Ngeyo wunkitula nyadi mu
bisalu bi mioko miaku,
ngeyo wutula bima bioso ku tsi malu mandi :
mamemi moso ayi zingombi zioso ;
bibulu bioso binsitu,
zinuni zi yilu ayi zimbizi zi mbu,
bibioso bindiatilanga mu minsolo mi mbu.
A Yave, Pfumu eto !
Tala buevi dizina diaku didi di nzitusu va ntoto wumvimba.
